faq.title: Clarity for management. Continuity for salespeople.

items.question: How does a WhatsApp CRM with artificial intelligence work?
items.answer: yapt. brings contacts, conversations, deals and activities into the same context. AI can qualify leads, summarize history and suggest replies; sequences organize follow-ups under defined rules. Your company decides where an agent acts and where a seller reviews, approves or takes over the negotiation.

items.question: How does the manager track productivity and targets?
items.answer: My day organizes activities, overdue work, next steps and signs of deals that need attention. The sales report brings together targets, actual results, conversion, time by stage and loss reasons, helping management decide where to support the team.

items.question: How does artificial intelligence help SDRs and prospecting?
items.answer: Agents can qualify leads against configured criteria and prepare context for an SDR or seller. The queue organizes opportunities and planned follow-ups; your team records calls, notes and next attempts in the deal. Sequences and activities help maintain follow-up continuity.

items.question: Is the sales forecast a revenue guarantee?
items.answer: No. The forecast uses rules, stage probabilities and history to help assess the period. A won deal, accepted proposal, confirmed order and money received are different situations and must be interpreted using the right criteria.

items.question: Can AI read audio, documents and data from our systems?
items.answer: Transcription, document analysis and integration tools can prepare information for AI and the team when enabled and configured. Format and processing limits apply; integrations depend on available systems, APIs and access.

items.question: Do we need to implement everything at once?
items.answer: We can prioritize one bottleneck and define a first scenario with clear indicators. Modules, permissions, data, integrations and team readiness guide the scope and its evolution.

items.question: Do I need to hire specialists to use the platform?
items.answer: You can use the platform with your own team or combine yapt. with specialists supporting its application. New Way also offers consulting for a defined problem, with or without the platform. The assessment helps identify the right approach for your operation.
